about: Words Arch does not allow. 'everywhere' is refused in profiles and in messages; 'profile' only in profiles (name, work, prompt answers, interests). Matched as whole words, in lower case, with look-alike digits and symbols read as letters (0 o, 1 i, 3 e, 4 a, 5 s, 7 t, @ a, $ s, ! i), a letter written more times than here still counting (niiice), and single letters spaced out (f u c k) read as one word. backend/043 loads this same file into private.blocked_terms; change both together. Reclaimed and ambiguous words (queer, dyke, homo, cum, dick) are left out on purpose: blocking them would block people describing themselves, a degree, or their name.
